name: call_attempts
sql:
CREATE TABLE call_attempts (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	campaign_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	recipient_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	provider VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	is_simulated BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	provider_call_id VARCHAR(100), 
	attempt_number INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	mode VARCHAR(10) DEFAULT 'main' NOT NULL, 
	call_language VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'queued' NOT NULL, 
	started_at DATETIME, 
	answered_at DATETIME, 
	completed_at DATETIME, 
	failure_reason VARCHAR(200), 
	next_retry_at DATETIME, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_call_attempts PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_attempt_number UNIQUE (recipient_id, attempt_number), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_call_attempts_mode CHECK (mode IN ('main', 'clarify')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_call_attempts_status CHECK (status IN ('queued', 'initiating', 'ringing', 'answered', 'completed', 'failed', 'busy', 'no_answer', 'voicemail', 'cancelled')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_call_attempts_attempt_number_positive CHECK (attempt_number >= 1), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_call_attempts_campaign_id_campaigns FOREIGN KEY(campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_call_attempts_recipient_id_recipients FOREIGN KEY(recipient_id) REFERENCES recipients (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

name: campaigns
sql:
CREATE TABLE campaigns (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	event_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	purpose VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'attendance_confirmation' NOT NULL, 
	messages JSON NOT NULL, 
	languages JSON NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'draft' NOT NULL, 
	scheduled_at DATETIME, 
	max_attempts INTEGER DEFAULT '3' NOT NULL, 
	require_consent BOOLEAN DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL, 
	is_demo BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_campaigns PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_campaigns_status CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'scheduled', 'running', 'completed', 'cancelled')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_campaigns_purpose CHECK (purpose IN ('attendance_confirmation', 'event_announcement', 'schedule_venue_update', 'submission_deadline_reminder', 'participant_followup')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_campaigns_max_attempts_range CHECK (max_attempts BETWEEN 1 AND 5), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_campaigns_event_id_events FOREIGN KEY(event_id) REFERENCES events (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

name: events
sql:
CREATE TABLE events (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	description VARCHAR(500) DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	approved_info JSON DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL, 
	organizer_contact VARCHAR(200), 
	is_demo BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_events PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

name: follow_ups
sql:
CREATE TABLE follow_ups (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	campaign_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	recipient_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	source_intent_id INTEGER, 
	action_type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL, 
	scheduled_at DATETIME, 
	note VARCHAR(300) DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	completed_at DATETIME, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_follow_ups PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_follow_ups_action_type CHECK (action_type IN ('callback', 'human_review', 'send_information', 'clarification')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_follow_ups_status CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'scheduled', 'completed', 'cancelled')), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_follow_ups_campaign_id_campaigns FOREIGN KEY(campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_follow_ups_recipient_id_recipients FOREIGN KEY(recipient_id) REFERENCES recipients (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_follow_ups_source_intent_id_intent_results FOREIGN KEY(source_intent_id) REFERENCES intent_results (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

name: import_runs
sql:
CREATE TABLE import_runs (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	event_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	campaign_id INTEGER, 
	filename VARCHAR(200) DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	rows_total INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	imported INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	rejected INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	reasons JSON DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL, 
	is_demo BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_import_runs PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_import_runs_kind CHECK (kind IN ('participants', 'leads')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_import_runs_counts_consistent CHECK (rows_total >= 0 AND imported >= 0 AND rejected >= 0 AND imported + rejected <= rows_total), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_import_runs_event_id_events FOREIGN KEY(event_id) REFERENCES events (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_import_runs_campaign_id_campaigns FOREIGN KEY(campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

name: intent_results
sql:
CREATE TABLE intent_results (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	call_attempt_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	recipient_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	campaign_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	intent VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	score FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	method VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	detected_language VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	evidence TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	notes JSON DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL, 
	needs_review BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	next_action VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	processing_status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'processed' NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_intent_results PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_intent_results_call_attempt_id UNIQUE (call_attempt_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_intent_results_intent CHECK (intent IN ('confirm', 'decline', 'callback_requested', 'information_requested', 'acknowledgement', 'opt_out', 'unclear', 'human_required')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_intent_results_method CHECK (method IN ('dtmf', 'rules', 'none')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_intent_results_score_range CHECK (score BETWEEN 0 AND 1), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_intent_results_call_attempt_id_call_attempts FOREIGN KEY(call_attempt_id) REFERENCES call_attempts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_intent_results_recipient_id_recipients FOREIGN KEY(recipient_id) REFERENCES recipients (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_intent_results_campaign_id_campaigns FOREIGN KEY(campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

name: leads
sql:
CREATE TABLE leads (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	event_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	phone VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	email VARCHAR(200), 
	source VARCHAR(30) DEFAULT 'manual' NOT NULL, 
	interest VARCHAR(100), 
	preferred_language VARCHAR(10), 
	consent_status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'unknown' NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'new' NOT NULL, 
	notes VARCHAR(500) DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	recipient_id INTEGER, 
	is_demo BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_leads PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_lead_event_phone UNIQUE (event_id, phone), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_leads_source CHECK (source IN ('registration_form', 'csv_import', 'manual', 'referral', 'walk_in')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_leads_status CHECK (status IN ('new', 'contacted', 'qualified', 'converted', 'lost')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_leads_consent_status CHECK (consent_status IN ('granted', 'unknown', 'revoked')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_leads_phone_e164 CHECK (length(phone) BETWEEN 9 AND 16 AND substr(phone, 1, 1) = '+'), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_leads_event_id_events FOREIGN KEY(event_id) REFERENCES events (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_leads_recipient_id_recipients FOREIGN KEY(recipient_id) REFERENCES recipients (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

name: provider_events
sql:
CREATE TABLE provider_events (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	provider VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	event_id VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	call_attempt_id INTEGER, 
	kind VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	result VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT 'applied' NOT NULL, 
	received_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_provider_events PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_provider_event UNIQUE (provider, event_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_provider_events_kind CHECK (kind IN ('status', 'response')), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_provider_events_call_attempt_id_call_attempts FOREIGN KEY(call_attempt_id) REFERENCES call_attempts (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

name: recipients
sql:
CREATE TABLE recipients (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	campaign_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	external_ref VARCHAR(100), 
	name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	phone VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	preferred_language VARCHAR(10), 
	segment VARCHAR(100), 
	consent_status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'unknown' NOT NULL, 
	opted_out BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	outcome VARCHAR(30) DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL, 
	is_demo BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	CONSTRAINT pk_recipients PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_recipient_campaign_phone UNIQUE (campaign_id, phone), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_recipients_consent_status CHECK (consent_status IN ('granted', 'unknown', 'revoked')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_recipients_outcome CHECK (outcome IN ('pending', 'confirmed', 'acknowledged', 'declined', 'callback_requested', 'information_requested', 'unclear', 'human_required', 'opted_out', 'no_response')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_recipients_phone_e164 CHECK (length(phone) BETWEEN 9 AND 16 AND substr(phone, 1, 1) = '+'), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_recipients_campaign_id_campaigns FOREIGN KEY(campaign_id) REFERENCES campaigns (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
